scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:infra && pnpm -r --parallel --filter catalyst-backend --filter catalyst-frontend run dev --host
scripts.dev:infra: cd catalyst-docker && podman-compose up -d --no-recreate postgres redis 2>/dev/null || podman-compose start postgres redis 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev:all: pnpm run dev:infra && pnpm -r --parallel --filter catalyst-backend --filter catalyst-frontend run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter catalyst-backend --filter catalyst-frontend run start
scripts.clean: rm -rf catalyst-backend/dist catalyst-backend/node_modules catalyst-frontend/dist catalyst-frontend/node_modules node_modules
